item.title: How the Enlightenment Remade Europe, and Then the World
item.description: A sweeping intellectual history of the Enlightenment, how Europe’s eighteenth-century revolt against superstition and tradition remade the foundations of politics, science, and human dignity, and why the world we live in is still inside that revolution.

item.title: The Institutional Mutation That Changed Everything
item.description: Why Europe’s rise wasn’t about genius or geography — it was about building the world’s first system that rewarded saying ‘I was wrong.’
